title: friendmarker
description: Mod that colors friend's armor into green
body:
![Armor preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7afbd34677354255ed5f84603a416d98e200d435.jpeg) 

This mod colors your friend's armor into green. That may help you in PvP so you don't so that you don't confuse friend with enemy.

Commands:
- /friend add <friend's name> - add your friend to list
- /friend clear - clears friendlist
- /friend remove <name> - remove friend from list

Settings:
- Visual Chestplate - Renders chestplate on friends that don't have armor (doesn't work on friends with invisibility effect) 
- Show [F] Tag - Renders [F] in friend's nametag 
- Color (Hex) - Edit overlay color

Dependencies:
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu/versions)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
